result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make sure that every person has reliable access to clean water, food, healthcare, and education — so that people wouldn’t have to fight just to get a fair shot at life.

In short: remove the most preventable suffering, so more people can live with dignity, safety, and opportunity.
